facts.fact: The 2026 Programme Based Budget Estimates of the Ministry of Communication, Digital Technology and Innovations appropriate GHS 536,745,448 of domestic money (GHS 42,486,769 from the Government of Ghana plus GHS 494,258,679 internally generated funds) to the NITA ICT Infrastructure and Regulation sub-programme for budget year 2026; a further GHS 138,000,000 of donor money is excluded.
